Extract the birth-death models fitted during grafting

Source: R/extract_BD_model_summary.R
extract_BD_model_summary.Rd

Extract the summary of the birth-death (BD) models fitted to simulate the divergence times of the grafted taxa. Returns a data.frame with one row per model, per grafted phylogeny (simulation and stochastic map). It is similar to phylograftR::extract_grafting_info(), but the summary is not computed a posteriori: the grafting functions record them if return_BD_model_summary = TRUE, and this function extracts the records.

Usage

extract_BD_model_summary(phy_grafted)

Arguments

phy_grafted

A grafted phylogeny (class "phylo"), a set of grafted phylogenies (class "multiPhylo", e.g., several simulations), or a list of them with one element per map (output of the grafting functions with a "multiSimmap"). The phylogenies must have the attribute "BD_model_summary", so they must be the output of phylograftR::graft_missing_taxa() (with method = "BD_clades") or phylograftR::graft_missing_clades() run with return_BD_model_summary = TRUE.

Value

A data.frame, with one row per model and phylogeny. The columns are:

  • map Character string. Name of the stochastic map (NA if no map was used).

  • simulation Integer. Index of the simulation.

  • seed Integer. Seed of the simulation (NA if unknown).

  • Clade_name Character string. Name of the initial clade (NA if it has no name). Only if Target_clade_name (or Sister_clade_name) was provided in missing_taxa_list.

  • Taxa Character string. Taxa that were grafted under this model, separated by commas.

  • n_taxa Integer. Number of taxa that were grafted under this model.

  • initial_clade_node Integer. Node ID in the backbone of the MRCA of the initial clade (target clade or sister clade). The ID of the tip for a single tip.

  • initial_clade_tips Character string. Pair of tips that defines the initial clade.

  • initial_clade_n_tips Integer. Number of tips of the initial clade in the backbone.

  • initial_clade_crown_age Numeric. Crown age of the initial clade (NA for a single tip).

  • enclosing Logical. Whether the model was fitted on an enclosing clade, because the initial clade has fewer than min_tips tips.

  • fitted_clade_node Integer. Node ID in the backbone of the MRCA of the clade used to fit the model (the same as initial_clade_node if enclosing = FALSE).

  • fitted_clade_tips Character string. Pair of tips that defines the fitted clade.

  • fitted_clade_n_tips Integer. Number of tips of the fitted clade when the model was fitted, including the taxa already grafted.

  • fitted_clade_n_backbone_tips Integer. Number of tips of the fitted clade in the backbone.

  • fitted_clade_crown_age Numeric. Crown age of the fitted clade.

  • min_tips Integer. Minimum number of tips required to fit the model.

  • b Numeric. Birth rate (speciation rate), in events per time unit per lineage.

  • d Numeric. Death rate (extinction rate) used to simulate the divergence times.

  • d_fitted Numeric. Death rate fitted by phytools::fit.bd(), before the adjustments.

  • d_adjustment Character string. "none", "set_to_0" or "capped" (see Details).

  • net_diversification Numeric. b - d.

  • relative_extinction Numeric. d / b.

  • rho Numeric. Sampling fraction of the fitted clade: tips present divided by tips present, taxa still to graft in the clade and unsampled species.

  • n_pending Integer. Number of taxa still to graft in the fitted clade when the model was fitted.

  • n_unsampled Numeric. Number of unsampled species in the fitted clade (see total_richness_per_clades in the grafting functions).

Attributes: "type" ("taxa" for models of graft_missing_taxa(), "clades" for models of graft_missing_clades(), "taxa_and_clades" for models of graft_missing_taxa_and_clades(), which have a column step).

Details

With phylograftR::graft_missing_taxa(), a model is fitted per target clade, and used by all the taxa of the target clade, whatever their stem availability or excluded subclades. With phylograftR::graft_missing_clades(), a model is fitted per missing clade, i.e., per sister clade.

The initial clade is the target clade (or the sister clade). The model is fitted on the initial clade if it has at least min_tips tips, otherwise on the smallest enclosing clade that has min_tips tips (enclosing = TRUE). The number of tips of the fitted clade counts the taxa already grafted when the model is fitted.

Clades are identified by their node in the backbone phylogeny provided to the grafting function, and by a pair of tips that defines the clade as their most recent common ancestor (a single tip for a clade made of one tip).

The death rate used to simulate the divergence times (d) can differ from the one fitted by phytools::fit.bd() (d_fitted): it is set to 0 if it is not finite or negative (d_adjustment = "set_to_0"), and capped at 99% of the birth rate (d_adjustment = "capped"), so the net diversification rate is always positive, which is needed to simulate divergence ages.

See also

Other functions from phylograftR:

  • phylograftR::graft_missing_taxa() to graft taxa within a target clade, with constraints (target clades and excluded subclades).

  • phylograftR::graft_missing_clades() to graft groups of missing taxa as clades sister to clades of the backbone.

  • phylograftR::graft_missing_taxa_and_clades() to graft missing taxa and missing clades in one run, with a single set of inputs.

  • phylograftR::extract_grafting_info() to extract a posteriori information on the location of grafted lineages.

  • phylograftR::extract_sampling_info() to extract the richness and the sampling fraction of the clades in each grafted phylogeny.

Author

Maël Doré

Examples

# --- Prepare data --- #

# Create a toy backbone phylogeny: ultrametric, with a root age of 50 time units
set.seed(1234)
phy <- ape::rcoal(n = 30)
phy$edge.length <- phy$edge.length / max(ape::node.depth.edgelength(phy)) * 50

# List the missing taxa to graft: 2 taxa in a clade of 9 tips, 1 taxon in a clade of 3 tips
missing_taxa_list <- list(
  Taxon_name = c("X1", "X2", "X3"),
  Target_clade = list(X1 = c("t26", "t3"), X2 = c("t26", "t3"), X3 = c("t5", "t12")))

# --- Graft the taxa, and report the BD models fitted --- #

grafted_phys <- graft_missing_taxa(phy = phy, missing_taxa_list = missing_taxa_list,
                                   return_BD_model_summary = TRUE,
                                   nb_simulations = 3, verbose = FALSE, seed = 1234)

# --- Extract the BD models --- #

BD_summary <- extract_BD_model_summary(phy_grafted = grafted_phys)
BD_summary[, c("simulation", "Taxa", "initial_clade_n_tips",
               "enclosing", "fitted_clade_n_tips", "b", "d", "rho")]
#>   simulation   Taxa initial_clade_n_tips enclosing fitted_clade_n_tips
#> 1          1 X1, X2                    9     FALSE                   9
#> 2          1     X3                    3      TRUE                  13
#> 3          2 X1, X2                    9     FALSE                   9
#> 4          2     X3                    3      TRUE                  13
#> 5          3 X1, X2                    9     FALSE                   9
#> 6          3     X3                    3      TRUE                  13
#>           b         d       rho
#> 1 0.3123828 0.2032879 0.8181818
#> 2 0.5507666 0.5452589 0.9285714
#> 3 0.3123828 0.2032879 0.8181818
#> 4 0.5507666 0.5452589 0.9285714
#> 5 0.3123828 0.2032879 0.8181818
#> 6 0.5507666 0.5452589 0.9285714

# The clade of 3 tips is smaller than min_tips = 5: the model is fitted on its enclosing clade
BD_summary[BD_summary$enclosing, c("Taxa", "initial_clade_tips", "fitted_clade_tips")]
#>   Taxa initial_clade_tips fitted_clade_tips
#> 2   X3            t5, t23            t8, t5
#> 4   X3            t5, t23            t8, t5
#> 6   X3            t5, t23            t8, t5
